name: Somchai Arunrat
bio:
Somchai Arunrat's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While studying engineering at Chulalongkorn University, he became fascinated by the intricate mechanics of race cars. He started by volunteering at local racing events, quickly proving his aptitude for technical problem-solving. After graduating, Somchai joined a small racing team, where he honed his skills in vehicle dynamics and race strategy. 

His pragmatic approach to management, coupled with a strong technical understanding, led to his appointment as team principal for the Reiza Studios Factory team. Somchai believes in fostering a collaborative environment where innovation and data-driven decision-making are paramount. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to extract maximum performance from his team through clear communication and strategic planning. He is committed to nurturing the talent within his team, believing that long-term success comes from investing in people.

physical.description: Somchai is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten technical notes.
Insists on personally reviewing all telemetry data after each practice session.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
